discrepancies.summary: U2 pin static RVA is wrong. review/evidence/README/SESSION_HANDOFF/ROADMAP/research-INDEX/PATH_MAP all claim complete string at 0x565d9a0 and substring 'luaL_loadbuffer %d--%s' at 0x565d9b2, asserting 'runtime RVA 0x565d9b2 == static'. Independent static check of work/u16-semantics-20260812/QemuSim/xbin/libFEProj.so (SHA 5e608f2d..., ELF PT_LOAD#1 identity-mapped, file offset==VA) shows the XOR-0x30 decoded complete string 'LuaEnv::DoCommand luaL_loadbuffer %d--%s' is at file offset 0x56bd9a0 and the substring at 0x56bd9b2 (off by 0x60000). At the claimed 0x565d9a0/0x565d9b2 the XOR-decoded content is 'System.currentPatterns.ActorComponentMovement.isMoveInput...' not luaL_loadbuffer. The '== static' claim does not hold; correct static location is 0x56bd9b2.

fault.txt is missing in 4 of 6 accepted run dirs (g1spont 20260818T155849.621386Z-g1spont-12332f and 20260818T160032.050790Z-g1spont-8b1e1c; critrng 20260818T163133.904601Z-critrng-53c326 and 20260818T163335.422229Z-critrng-22323d). Only the 2 g2cons runs contain fault.txt. Contradicts the claim that every run dir contains fault.txt.

g1spont and critrng attempt.json lack an explicit 'exception' field (task expected 'exception null'). Only g2cons attempts carry 'exception': null. Equivalent to null given fault.status=normal and survival.alive=true, but the field is absent.

g2-consumer-evidence.json claims g2probe-11e666 has a_static_hits:3, a_probe_hits:0, a_alt_hits:0, and closure_caller_bt, but the run's raw artifacts (events.jsonl/hooks-last-50.jsonl/rpc-results.jsonl/attempt.json) contain no such hit counts or backtrace - only probeanchor 'all attached' status and fetest_touch.observed=false. The anchor-hit claim is not reproducible from the raw run directory.
